provenance.note: Where the oil enters the water, as a Point: the pick's {coordinates, name} verbatim, a (lon, lat) pair, 'lat,lon', a point layer, or a place name. Its name becomes the tracer's name, and on a river with no domain supplied it is also the seed the reach is walked downstream from [supplied on this invocation]
Finite pulse injection window [supplied on this invocation]
Point-source discharge of the release itself, small against the carrier flow [supplied on this invocation]
Concentration of the DISSOLVED fraction released with the slick, carried as the water's tracer [supplied on this invocation]

Which preset was spilled: light_crude | diesel | heavy_fuel - the module's own composition, density and viscosity. Crude runs as light_crude, gasoline and petrol as diesel, bunker as heavy_fuel [supplied on this invocation]
How many floating particles the module tracks; the slick is drawn from their positions, so a coarse count draws a coarse slick [supplied on this invocation]
The solver step the floats are released at, compiled into the module's own release routine; it lets the flow field establish before the slick is put on it [supplied on this invocation]

Simulated physical time the run covers. The clock the run is settled on, so the deck's DURATION and every window read off it are this one number; what is long enough is the question's, and a question that knows states its own [supplied on this invocation]

Target element edge or cell length the domain is resolved at. The granularity is the USER's lever: no sizing rung derives an edge from a channel nobody surveyed, so the number the run meshes at is either yours or this labeled default [supplied on this invocation]
Along-domain release position, 0=inflow..1=outflow; the source must sit strictly INSIDE the domain, never on a boundary [declared scenario default]
How often the particle positions are written; it converts to a count of solver steps at the run's own timestep [declared scenario default]
Sustained wind driving a surface wind-stress term; 0 = no wind [declared scenario default]
Compass bearing the wind blows FROM (0=N, 90=E); only read when wind_speed_mps > 0 [declared scenario default]
not supplied; every observed row is read at the most recent cycle its own source has published
